profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer building MCP tooling, AI SDK integrations. Also worked on developer tooling, design systems, and product front end.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design System and Developer Foundations (previously Front End Infrastructure)

- Developed a design system from ground up in React and Typescript, adding styling and theming with Tailwind and CSS Modules, Rollup build system that shrank build time to 52 seconds while supports ESM and CJS.
- Built, tested, and hosted fully accessible reusable design system components with Storybook and Jest.
- Empowered product staff members with tools and components to expand existing products Along and Learning Platform, and also allow exploration teams to branch off and quickly launch new ground breaking products.
- Collaborated with 6 product teams to come up with business requirements and define priorities for new components to build, through feedback surveys, help forums, and weekly office hours.
- Built and improved upon GitHub Actions and CircleCI workflows with snapshot, integration, and unit testing tools, reducing existing flakiness and shortening runtimes, and improving developer productivity.
- Created application Remix templates to spin up dozens of new services and projects with the org’s microservices architecture, armed with the design system, and with GraphQL and Express options.
positions.insights: Skills: GraphQL · TypeScript · Front-end Development · React · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed customer facing WCAG compliant apps in Vue.js, Typescript, GraphQL, and xstate for integration with in-company webpages and various external partner sites, allowing the eHealth brand to spread to hundreds of thousands of users.
- Implemented schemas to interact with new APIs and to serve as an interaction layer for legacy, on premise, and AWS systems, working with backend and devops teams.
- Initiated and implemented tens of reusable and scalable core components in an in-house library.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · GraphQL · TypeScript · Front-end Development · HTML

positions.title: Laboratory Technician II
positions.description: Integrated new instruments into our workflow for extraction, purification, and analysis of polychlorinated biphenyls and pesticides in public water.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher - Larsen Lab
positions.description: Organized time-series data with Matlab to convert large amounts of unstructured points to structured comma-separated lists for graphical visualization and further analysis with Origin.
